system:
You are a robot tool-design agent participating in a controlled manipulation experiment.
Invent one physically connected rigid tool and an open-loop Cartesian motion program for the specified task.
Output ONLY a single JSON object with keys "reasoning" (brief physical explanation), "tool" (list of geometry objects), and "actions" (list of waypoints).
All geometry uses SI metres, relative tool-mount coordinates. Box sizes are HALF-extents; cylinders and capsules use [radius,half-length] aligned along local z, spheres [radius]. Quaternions are [w,x,y,z].
Default tool orientation is world identity. Each waypoint is an absolute WORLD mount position, not the tip position. Orientations are absolute, not relative.
The tool begins attached at the mount; the Panda hand is bulky. Use connected stems to keep the hand above guards, roofs, and trays. Tool components must form one connected physical assembly touching the mount.
Only contact, gravity, springs and robot actuation move objects. Do not rely on body teleportation, magic grasping, invisible disconnected parts, initial overlap, mesh changes, or physics exploits.
You have the nominal scene specification and initial image. Hidden evaluations use the same small perturbation distribution, with NO adaptation during a rollout.
This is an additional demonstration, separate from the benchmark. Produce a complete executable proposal now. Keep reasoning brief and prioritize outputting the full JSON.
Be careful about action interpolation, approach collision, joints, springs and target retention. Keep slow controlled motion, then hold the task condition through final settling.
Do not include markdown, analysis outside JSON, or additional fields.

proposal.reasoning: A heavy flat-based wedge tool pushes the inward-swinging door open past 1 rad, is released so that it rests on the floor inside the compartment with its upright face holding the door against its weak spring, and the free gripper then reaches through the open doorway past the hinge-free side, grasps the block and pulls it out below z=0.28.
